Full summary: Task 7 (inline): client index store implemented TDD-first — src/dashboard/public/js/store.js (pure ESM, no DOM) with load/delta-poll/count-validation/filter/facetCounts/scopeChildren; 12 unit tests green, full suite 1164 pass.
Decisions: Chose union-of-keys generic status-count comparison in the store's validation (countsMatch iterates the union of local and server decision-status keys) — handles the archived fifth key and any future status without client changes, per the Task 2 contract finding.; Documented a known blind spot rather than engineering around it: a superseded→archived flip with no other project activity is invisible to /api/status counts, so the store catches it on the next real change via post-merge count validation — accepted because twining_archive always posts an archiver summary to the blackboard in practice, which changes blackboard counts and triggers the poll anyway.
